g.text: Field F[k, c]: 39 slices x 61 lateral cells, cost per second

text.tspan: Each row the walker is 1.4 m/s x 0.1 s = 0.14 m further on.
Every obstacle point moves 0.14 m closer per row, and nothing moves sideways
unless motion prediction is switched on, which it isn't by default.
Then the terms add, each at weight 1.
At slice 14, candidate x = 0, a post at (0.5, 2.0) m with N = 0.0337 m:
this term: worst point within a group,
(today the scene sends one point per group,
so the max has one point to pick from)
